replies.pt: Ackman diz que o conselho da Nvidia age contra os acionistas ao recusar trazer Jensen Huang de volta como CEO (4.211 lk / 168 rep).
replies.a: bill ackman walking into the nvidia board chat like he pays rent there is peak investor behavior
replies.b: shareholder fights hit different when you can act on them at 3am. onchain the stock never clocks out
replies.c: unpopular take: a board saying no to the founder isn't a scandal, it's a governance test. the market prices it either way

replies.pt: O IPO mais esperado do Q4 comeca a negociar amanha, tokenizado pela xStocks desde o primeiro dia ($ANTx) (96 lk / 8 rep).
replies.a: imagine telling someone in 2019 the hottest ipo of the quarter would be tradable before the coffee machine warms up
replies.b: $ANTx from day one, on mantle, around the clock. no waiting for the open to have a position
replies.c: day one of an ipo is just the first day of price discovery, not the last. tokenizing it from the start is the part that matters

replies.pt: O app vai mostrar o que acontece entre o sino de abertura e a primeira negociacao de um IPO — a descoberta de preco ao vivo (61 lk / 28 rep).
replies.a: the opening bell is a vibes-based countdown and we all pretend otherwise
replies.b: a listing is not a market, execution is. that gap between the bell and the first print is exactly where onchain grew up
replies.c: price discovery is the only interesting part of an ipo, and it's the part retail always sees last

replies.pt: Uma baleia montou short de US$ 93,87 mi em Anthropic na Hyperliquid antes da estreia (245 lk / 53 rep). Numero da fonte.
replies.a: a whale shorting an ipo before it lists is the most onchain sentence i've read today
replies.b: someone is already trading the ipo before the bell rings. that's the whole 24/7 argument in one position
replies.c: everyone loves tokenized equities until a $93M short shows up. that's when the market gets real

replies.pt: Pergunta de engajamento: "se a sua estrategia de trade fosse um jogo, como se chamaria?" (64 lk / 35 rep).
replies.a: mine's called "buy high and call it a long term thesis"
replies.b: mine would be "no closing bell", which is also why i like stocks onchain
replies.c: if your strategy needs a game name, it's probably a game and not a strategy

replies.b: listed on nasdaq in the morning, trading on mantle at 2am. no bell in between
replies.c: everyone argues about the ipo price. nobody asks what happens when the news lands at 3am

replies.pt: Fed espera mais altas de juros e alerta que IA pode empurrar a inflacao para cima (2.703 lk / 266 rt / 282 rep).

replies.b: the fed speaks and half the market is asleep. onchain there is no closing bell between the print and your exit
replies.c: inflationary in everything except the cost of moving a stock onchain

replies.pt: Nvidia antecipa aumentos e grants de acoes para segurar funcionarios depois da saida de Jensen Huang, per WIRED (296 lk / 20 rt / 74 rep).
replies.a: needing a raise to stay at the company that printed the chart of the decade is wild
replies.b: the chart does not wait for the all-hands to end when the venue never closes
replies.c: retention packages are just a bull market with an expiry date

replies.pt: O CEO da Securitize admite que a industria ama siglas — ISTs, TSVs, CETs — e diz que a graca e mais gente usando esses ativos (24 lk / 4 rt / 2 rep).

replies.b: call it whatever, the part that matters is where it trades: a venue with no closing auction
replies.c: the acronym is not the product. the wrapper is
